visualReview.scope: All eleven final refreshed-HTML figures and their captions were visually inspected at both viewport widths. Three representative Appendix C tools, one per level, were inspected at both widths; all thirty levels were verified by DOM at both widths.
observations: No cropped figure text, box overflow, unintended arrow/text collisions, or caption clipping in the 22 final figure screenshots.
All eleven mobile figures fit their reading column without horizontal figure scrolling; ten are about 330.5 CSS px wide and the urge illustration inside a padded callout is about 309.2 CSS px wide.
The behavioral diagram connects the judgment boundary to choice; the urge curve is separate from the optional observation prompts; the Lally model estimates are separate from the illustrative curve.
Three tool levels now have visible textual badges and distinct blue, teal, and purple borders.

The first Appendix C decision-journal table uses an intentional local horizontal scroll area on mobile. A follow-up DOM check found table client width 309 px, scroll width 365 px, and overflow-x:auto; the tool box and page do not overflow. This is distinct from the eleven phone-fitting figures.
resolvedInitialFindings: Habit and conversation inline image widths expanded to 100 percent.
Urge body and axis font increased to 30 SVG units, with the final practice prompt wrapped.
Heuristic footer increased to 28 SVG units.
Tool-class CSS specificity corrected so level colors are displayed.
visualReview.captureConvention: Fixed navigation overlays were hidden only during element screenshot capture, without changing content geometry. Optional figure callouts were opened for image review; the six comparison sections were verified on fresh default page loads.
visualReview.limitations: HTML in local Chrome at desktop1440 and mobile390 only; this does not certify EPUB, all historical figures, or native Safari rendering.

limitations: Focused eleven-figure reading-route audit; not all book figures.
Source SVG font sizes are scaled by the smaller measured width/height ratio, allowing for desktop contain letterboxing; CSS font substitution is separately screened using browser-computed SVG text.
Optional figure notes are opened only for figure inspection; comparison visibility is checked on fresh default page loads.
No EPUB or whole-book content audit.
Screenshot crops hide fixed navigation overlays only; figure layout and measured geometry are not changed.
